LengthExpr.description: A length: a number in the design's length unit, or an expression such as "w / 2" or "30 mm".

NumberExpr.description: A number with no unit, or an expression such as "k / 2".

ReliefShape.description: notch, round, rectangular or tear, in any case (blanks around it are ignored).

SheetAngleDisplay.description: bend or included, ignoring case and surrounding blanks.

SheetRuleName.description: Trimmed, nonempty rule name, at most 128 bytes after trimming.

input.description:
Create or edit a sheet metal rule, activate it, or delete it. Expressions may use design
parameters; `Thickness` inside a rule's other expressions is that rule's thickness.
The handler evaluates dimensions and ranges against the design after checking the contract.

active.description:
Make this the active rule. Default: true if there is no saved active rule, otherwise false.
False leaves the active choice unchanged; ignored when deleting.

angle_display.description:
How DXF bend notes show angles: bend or included, ignoring case and surrounding blanks.
Ignored when deleting.

bend_radius.description: Inner bend radius, nonnegative. Ignored when deleting.

corner_relief.description: Corner relief size across. Ignored when deleting.

corner_relief_shape.description: Corner relief shape. Ignored when deleting.

delete.description:
Delete the named saved rule instead of editing it. Default: false. Deleting the active
rule clears that choice; listing then uses the first remaining rule, else built-in steel.

gap.description: Gap between meeting flanges. Ignored when deleting.

hem_gap.description: Inner radius of flat hems. Ignored when deleting.

k_factor.description: Neutral-axis fraction, from 0 to 1. Ignored when deleting.

name.description:
The rule's name (trimmed, nonempty, at most 128 bytes). A new rule inherits the active
rule's fields; an existing rule keeps fields not given here.

relief_depth.description: Bend relief depth. Ignored when deleting.

relief_width.description: Bend relief width. Ignored when deleting.

thickness.description: Thickness, more than 0 and less than 10000 mm. Ignored when deleting.

input.title: ManageRulesParams

label: Sheet Metal Rules

RuleFeatureError.description: A feature that failed to rebuild after a rule was edited.

RuleReply.description:
A saved rule's expressions, including the default bend-angle display which the saved
design omits. These are expressions, not evaluated values.

RuleValuesReply.description: Evaluated rule values: lengths in millimetres, dimensionless K-factor and canonical choices.

output.description: A successful rule edit or deletion, preserving the existing reply alternatives.
output.title: ManageRulesResult

params: name (new or existing); thickness?, k_factor?, bend_radius?, relief_width?, relief_depth?, corner_relief?, hem_gap?, gap? (expressions; `Thickness` is the rule's; gap: between flanges that meet at a corner, whose ends are closed toward each other at any angle); corner_relief_shape?: notch|round|rectangular|tear (what is cut where two bends meet at a corner of the base: round and rectangular a relief `corner_relief` across; tear none, each bend's end is cut straight from the corner to its flange's end; default notch); angle_display?: bend|included (how the DXF bend notes read the bend angles: the bend angle, default, or the included angle left between the bend's sides, 180° less it; the bend table gives both, and a flange's `angle` is always the bend angle); active?: bool; delete?: bool
